lines.zh: 轻轻扇动翅膀飞过草原。
lines.en: Gently flap wings over the plains.

lines.zh: 低低掠过地面寻找食物。
lines.en: Skim low over the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫过草地收集金粒。
lines.en: Brush tail over grass, collecting gold grains.
Fly to the distant lake for a meal.
Fly out of sight of the player.
Rest on rocks basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 小小翅膀，扑棱两下就起来。
lines.en: Tiny wings — two flaps and I'm up.
Skimming the grass tips, tail sweeping.
An iron nugget still clutched in my claws.

lines.zh: 偶尔转动脑袋寻找猎物。
lines.en: Occasionally turn head to search for prey.
Scan the surroundings with its gaze.

lines.zh: 轻柔地梳理自己的羽毛。
享受着午后温暖的阳光。
lines.en: Basks in the warm afternoon sun.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出轻微的嘶嘶声。

lines.en: Wind slips into the cave; nice.
My ear turns; I heard that.

lines.zh: 用锐利的眼神盯着玩家。
lines.en: Fixes sharp gaze on the player.

lines.zh: 警觉地观察着玩家的举动。
靠近玩家但保持一定距离。
lines.en: Approaches the player but keeps a distance.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶警告声。
尝试靠近玩家但被吓退。
lines.en: Attempts to approach the player but backs off.
Swishes tail as a warning to the player.

lines.zh: 我只有巴掌大，你也举刀。
lines.en: I am no bigger than your palm, and you raise your blade.
Attempts to approach the player but fails.
Put the sword down and I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 你不穿盔甲，看着温和些。
lines.en: No armor on you; you look gentler.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，快给我食物！
lines.en: My wings are hurt! Feed me!
My stomach hurts, give me some cod!
My wings are bitten, it hurts!
I'm lost, I can't find home!
My wing is torn; stop hitting me.

lines.zh: 轻咬鱼饵，发出细微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Gently nips at the bait, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 在空中盘旋，寻找鳕鱼踪迹。
lines.en: Circling in the air, searching for the scent of cod.

lines.zh: 低空掠过水面，捕捉鳕鱼。
用爪子抓起一块金粒，仔细研究。
lines.en: Picks up a gold grain, inspecting it closely.

lines.zh: 鳕鱼干的味道，先给我闻。
lines.en: Let me smell that dried cod first.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，接近鳕鱼。
lines.en: Makes a low growl, closing in on the cod.

lines.zh: 小心翼翼地靠近，以免惊扰鳕鱼。
lines.en: Approaches cautiously, not to scare the cod.

lines.zh: 发现鳕鱼后，迅速俯冲捕食。
lines.en: Dives swiftly upon spotting the cod.

lines.zh: 吞下鳕鱼，发出满意的咕噜声。
lines.en: Swallows the cod, making contented sounds.
Rests on the shore, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 尖锐的龙喙撞向岩石，发出撞击声。
lines.en: Sharp dragon beak collides with rock, making a clattering sound.

lines.zh: 与另一只Terrible Terror激烈搏斗。
lines.en: Fierce combat with another Terrible Terror.

lines.zh: 被同伴的攻击激怒，展开攻击。
lines.en: Angered by a companion's attack, launches an assault.

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打敌人，试图推开。
lines.en: Tails swat at the enemy, trying to push it away.

lines.zh: 发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，警告入侵者。
lines.en: Rumbling roar to warn off intruders.

lines.zh: 翅膀撞在一起，试图占上风。
lines.en: Wings collide, trying to gain the upper hand.
Collided and sent flying several meters.

lines.zh: 撞上树干，发出沉重的撞击声。
lines.en: Collides with a tree trunk, a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 尾巴被同伴抓住，试图挣脱。
lines.en: Tail grabbed by a companion, trying to break free.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的求偶声，吸引伴侣。
lines.en: Low growl to attract a mate.
Flying in the air, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 用翅膀轻拂伴侣，表达爱意。
lines.en: Gently brushes with its wings, showing affection.

lines.zh: 围绕飞行，展示自己的飞行技巧。
lines.en: Flying in circles, showcasing its flying skills.

lines.zh: 发出吸引伴侣的嘶嘶声。
在地面上梳理羽毛，准备交配。
lines.en: Preens on the ground, preparing for mating.
Patrols the territory with a mate.
Rub beaks together, strengthening their bond.

lines.zh: 用翅膀轻触伴侣，表达亲密。
lines.en: Gently touches with its wings, showing closeness.

lines.zh: 这些食物让我的翅膀更轻。
金粒堆在洞里，谁也别碰。
lines.en: My gold nuggets are in that hole — hands off.
I am small, but my teeth are not.
On this patch, my roar is the loudest.
Fire can't hurt me. Can it hurt you?
One bite, just one, to taste.

lines.zh: 抓住你的腿，你动弹不得！

lines.en: A peck at your head from above!
One wingbeat, dust in your eyes!

lines.zh: 我这副小身板，从岩缝里钻出来。
lines.en: This small body squeezes out of a rock crack.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里挤出来，灰头土脸。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack, covered in dust.

lines.zh: 从枝条间钻出来，翅膀还湿。
lines.en: Out of the branches, wings still damp.
Nest behind the rock; don't go there.
Only me left in this clutch.
The wind brought me to this land.

lines.zh: 我从树枝上掉下来，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: I fell off the branch before my wings opened.
A small body like mine took an arrow.

lines.zh: 饿得不行了，给点鳕鱼吧！
